description: This file contains an embedded Dart code example demonstrating the definition and use of a Dart class 'Die'. It defines HTML structure, links to stylesheets and scripts, and includes an inline Dart code snippet inside a textarea element used with CodeMirror.

classes.name: Die
classes.description: A Dart class modeling a die with a specified number of sides, providing a method to roll it and track the last roll.

methods.name: main
methods.description: The entry point of the Dart script that creates a 'Die' object and prints the result of rolling it.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the last roll as a string, used for display purposes.

methods.name: roll
methods.description: Simulates rolling the die by generating a random number between 1 and the number of sides.
